description: Android activity class implementing a particle simulation controlled by accelerometer data, including inner classes for particles and particle system, sensor event handling, and rendering logic.

classes.name: AccelerometerPlayActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing sensor setup, wake lock, and simulation view lifecycle.

classes.name: SimulationView
classes.description: Custom view handling rendering, sensor event listening, and particle physics simulation.

classes.name: Particle
classes.description: Represents individual particles with physics computation and collision resolution.

classes.name: ParticleSystem
classes.description: Manages a collection of particles, updating their positions and resolving collisions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes sensor, power, display, wake lock, and simulation view.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Acquires wake lock and starts sensor-based simulation.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Stops simulation and releases wake lock.

methods.name: startSimulation
methods.description: Registers sensor listener for accelerometer events.

methods.name: onSensorChanged
methods.description: Handles accelerometer data, adjusting for device rotation, and updates sensor timestamp.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws background and particles based on physics simulation and sensor data.
